Patient D is meeting all milestones for discharge, however he continues to have significant head pain at the site of his craniotomy. During your pre-discharge physical examination, you note that there is expected frontal scalp swelling and tenderness to palpation of his incision site. You review the medication administration record and see that he has required 1 dose of hydrocodone every 6 hours for pain control.
Question: Would you offer a hydrocodone prescription to Patient D? Yes or No? If yes, how much supply would you give – Low (1 week), or High (4 weeks) supply? Explain.
